effects.projectFixed &&
            remediationFixed(item as unknown as JsonRecordLike, document, String(receiptId)),
evidence.reason: The current code still passes the receipt-status projection `item` into `remediationFixed` at lines 454-455. That projection does not include `subject`, while `remediationFixed` compares the remediation subject/source against `item.subject`; with `projectFixed` enabled, the comparison cannot match valid evidence and `fixed` remains false. The call should receive the mapped queue item instead.
